_README: Hand-written declaration of the commit sources `scripts/release-notes.py brief` gathers a week from BESIDES this repository's own git log. The emulator patches this project lives on are pushed to public forks, so a brief cut from this repo alone silently under-reports the week. One hand-written home per fact: the forks, the branches each build actually pins, who counts as us, and WHY a branch is excluded. `render` and `check` never read this file for prose — it feeds `brief` only.
_ourAuthorsNote: GitHub author logins. Every other author on these branches is upstream MAME/VICE/QEMU/es40 work this project merely carries — never ours to announce in the notes.
_ourCommitAuthorsNote: GitHub can only attach a login to a commit whose author email belongs to a GitHub account, so work pushed straight from the lab box arrives with NO login and the `ourAuthors` rule cannot see it (this is how the VICE shared-memory framebuffer nearly went unreported). These are the plain git author names and emails that count as ours anyway, matched case-insensitively and ONLY when GitHub resolved no login. The list is deliberately short: the box's other identity is root@<the machine>, a real hostname that cannot be written down in a public repo, so anything unattributed and undeclared is printed under `brief`'s DECIDE BY HAND block for a human call instead of being dropped.
_experimentalMarkerNote: A commit whose own subject carries this marker is published for the record but is not part of the shipped stack, so it never reaches the brief.

forks.what: MAME patches for the SGI Indy (IRIX) and Microprofessor II stations

branches.name: irix
branches.what: R4600 DRC, GIO64/Newport shm framebuffer and mamectl input for the IRIX station
branches.pinNote: the mame-irix submodule IS the pin; scripts/build-guests/emulators/build-mame-irix.sh (and build-mame-macos.sh) build from the checked-out submodule and choose no branch of their own.

branches.name: mpf2
branches.what: warning-suppression and boot patches for the Microprofessor II station
branches.pinNote: the mame-mpf2 submodule IS the pin; scripts/build-guests/emulators/build-mame-mpf2.sh seeds its chroot build from the checked-out submodule and chooses no branch of its own.

excludes.why: published working patches that are DELIBERATELY not shipped in the default stack (third_party/mame-irix README.md) — the gallery never runs them, so announcing them would claim a capability visitors do not have

forks.what: es40 AlphaServer ES40 patches behind the Windows 2000 Alpha and Tru64 UNIX stations

branches.name: main
branches.what: JIT translation cache, shm framebuffer export, mamectl/1 ctlsock input, savestate fixes

excludes.why: a trial optimisation branch that never merged to main and never ran a station — trial tests are not interesting from a visitor's perspective

forks.what: VICE patches for the Commodore stations (shm framebuffer, checkpoint save/load, keyboard pacing)

branches.name: kernel-hive/integrated
branches.what: the integrated branch every Commodore station is built from

forks.what: QEMU patches for the foreign-architecture stations (Rhapsody i8259 cascade, Mac OS 7.5.3 m68k, AIX 4.3.3 on an RS/6000 40p) and the host's fast-poll build

branches.name: kernel-hive
branches.what: the branch the Rhapsody and Mac OS 7.5.3 builders clone

branches.name: aix432-s3
branches.what: the graphical PReP/PowerPC stack the aix432 station is built on: Hervé Poussineau's unmerged S3 Trio card forward-ported to 11.0.2 (a console for the firmware), a NEW hw/display/mga.c — the Matrox behind IBM's GXT130P, the only adapter AIX 4.3 can bind to — Artyom Tarasenko's lsi53c810/raven AIX fixes, a PS/2 scancode-set-3 ACK fix that unblocks every /dev/lft0 open, and the PREP_TB_FREQ override the genuine IBM 40p boot ROM needs to get past its 601 clock path

_notInScope.Wnt/forwarder: the public ingress/deploy repo, not an emulator fork: TLS and relay plumbing rather than anything a museum visitor would notice
